audit_result.proof_trace: Deposit validation failures are wrapped as execReqErr, which is detected at receive_block.go:516 and returned as a raw error (L517) instead of being wrapped in invalidBlock. This violates the property that all deposit validation failures must terminate with InvalidBlock.
audit_result.attack_scenario: Attacker submits a P2P block with nil or invalid deposit request. The validation error returns as raw execReqErr rather than invalidBlock, bypassing proper block invalidation in fork choice and potentially allowing invalid blocks to propagate.

PROP-ff7df16a-post-001.text: Every deposit validation failure must terminate with an InvalidBlock exception.

audit_result.proof_trace: Signature verification is bypassed when a seen block arrives but the chain head has moved to a different (slot, proposer). The equivocation detector early-returns without calling VerifyProposerSlashing if headBlock slot/proposer doesn't match incoming block, allowing resubmitted blocks with invalid signatures to be ignored unverified.
audit_result.attack_scenario: Attacker sends Block A (valid) at slot N which becomes head and is cached. Chain advances to slot N+1. Attacker resends slot N with same proposer but crafted invalid signature. The seen-cache triggers equivocation check, but head mismatch causes early return at L498-501, bypassing signature verification entirely.

PROP-56ad1eb2-inv-032.text: Dedup cache hit must not bypass signature verification on resubmitted items with different proofs.
PROP-56ad1eb2-inv-032.assertion: forall item, seen_set: item.id in seen_set => verify_signature(item.sig) must still execute on new instance

audit_result.proof_trace: The invariant is enforced at runtime via SetProposerLookahead (validates length on L18-19), but InitializeFromProtoUnsafeFulu bypasses this check by directly copying the protobuf field without validation (L649-652). States deserialized from SSZ or loaded from the database can have arbitrary proposer lookahead lengths, violating the (MIN_SEED_LOOKAHEAD+1)*SLOTS_PER_EPOCH invariant.
audit_result.attack_scenario: An attacker provides a malicious checkpoint state via SSZ with proposer_lookahead length != 64. The SSZ deserializer (configfork.go:171) or database loader (state.go:552) calls InitializeFromProtoUnsafeFulu, which accepts the invalid length. Subsequent ProcessProposerLookahead calls assume correct length for array indexing (transition.go:34-35), causing out-of-bounds access or incorrect proposer selection.

PROP-56ad1eb2-inv-006.text: Proposer lookahead length must always be (MIN_SEED_LOOKAHEAD+1)*SLOTS_PER_EPOCH after epoch processing.
PROP-56ad1eb2-inv-006.assertion: forall state s post epoch: len(s.proposer_lookahead) == (MIN_SEED_LOOKAHEAD+1)*SLOTS_PER_EPOCH

audit_result.proof_trace: TOCTOU race: hasSeenDataColumnIndex check (L157) happens during validation, but setSeenDataColumnIndex (subscriber_data_column_sidecar.go:42) only executes after ValidationAccept is returned and the handler runs. Two identical sidecars arriving concurrently both pass the check before either is marked as seen, allowing duplicate acceptance.
audit_result.attack_scenario: Attacker broadcasts two identical data column sidecars to different peers; both arrive at victim node simultaneously, pass validation concurrently (both see cache miss), both return ValidationAccept before either marks the tuple as seen in the cache, resulting in duplicate acceptance.

PROP-6a4369e9-inv-012.text: Deduplication key (slot, proposer_index, sidecar.index) must prevent duplicate acceptance.
PROP-6a4369e9-inv-012.assertion: forall s1,s2: accepted(s1) && accepted(s2) && same_dedup_key(s1,s2) => s1 == s2

audit_result.proof_trace: The RPC handler serves data columns directly from storage without verifying their parent block passed state transition. Data columns are saved asynchronously (subscriber_beacon_blocks.go:40) before block validation completes (L42). The storage retrieval at L123 has no state transition check.
audit_result.attack_scenario: Attacker proposes a block with invalid state transition. The execution-side data column reconstruction (processDataColumnSidecarsFromExecution) runs async and saves columns to storage before ReceiveBlock validation fails. Peers requesting via DataColumnSidecarsByRoot RPC receive invalid sidecars during the race window.

PROP-6a4369e9-inv-026.text: Sidecars must not be served for blocks failing beacon-chain state transition.
PROP-6a4369e9-inv-026.assertion: forall sidecar in resp: state_transition_valid(sidecar.block) == true
